_doc: UI test of the view-mode bar (studio/viewmodes.js) in The Character Creator: syssling_wrap20 is opened, every shading button draws the body its own way (wireframe, clay with the eyes kept, matcap, normals, UV checker, albedo, own material), Edges adds an overlay that follows the mesh and goes away again, X-ray makes the body see-through, Z opens the pie and 3 picks Matcap, the choice is remembered, and the paint mode hides the bar and gives it back. Nothing is written to disk. Run against studio-test: url with port 8771.
name: creator_viewmodes

steps.eval: (() => { window.__body = () => { let b = null; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && !o.userData.vmOverlay && !/eye|low-poly/i.test(`${o.name} ${o.userData.own?.name ?? ''}`) && (!b || o.geometry.attributes.position.count > b.geometry.attributes.position.count)) b = o; }); return b; }; window.__eyes = () => { const e = []; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && !o.userData.vmOverlay && /eye|low-poly/i.test(`${o.name} ${o.userData.own?.name ?? ''}`)) e.push(o); }); return e; }; window.__click = (id) => document.querySelector(`#huview .vm-bar .vm-btn[data-mode="${id}"]`).click(); window.__kind = () => { const m = __body().material; return { type: m.type, wire: !!m.wireframe, own: m === __body().userData.own, map: m.map?.image?.width ?? 0, tone: m.toneMapped, transparent: !!m.transparent, opacity: m.opacity }; }; const r = document.querySelector('#huview .vm-bar').getBoundingClientRect(), side = document.querySelector('#huside').getBoundingClientRect(); return { bar: [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height], side: side.left, buttons: document.querySelectorAll('#huview .vm-bar .vm-btn').length }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#huview .vm-bar').getBoundingClientRect(), side = document.querySelector('#huside').getBoundingClientRect(), steps = document.querySelector('.hu-steps').getBoundingClientRect(); return !document.querySelector('#huview .vm-bar').hidden && r.right <= side.left && r.top >= steps.top && document.querySelectorAll('#huview .vm-bar .vm-btn').length === 9 && !document.querySelector('#huside .vm-bar'); })()
steps.label: the bar sits on the view, left of the side panel and apart from the cards, with 7 modes and 2 overlays

steps.expect: (() => { const k = __kind(); return k.type === 'MeshBasicMaterial' && k.wire && !__body().castShadow && document.querySelector('#huview .vm-label').textContent === 'Wireframe'; })()
steps.label: Wireframe draws the edges only, without shadow

steps.expect: (() => { const k = __kind(); return k.type === 'MeshStandardMaterial' && !k.wire && !k.own && __body().material.color.getHexString() === 'c9a58e' && __eyes().every((e) => e.material === e.userData.own) && __body().castShadow; })()
steps.label: Clay draws one neutral material and the eyes keep their own
Normals draws the surface direction (a normal matcap)
UV checker lays the checker on the UV
Albedo shows the own colour map without light or tone mapping
Material gives the own material back

steps.eval: (() => { __click('matcap'); document.querySelector('#huview .vm-bar button[aria-label="Edges"]').click(); let n = 0, skin = 0; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) { n++; if (o.isSkinnedMesh === o.parent.isSkinnedMesh && o.geometry === o.parent.geometry) skin++; } }); return { n, skin }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { let n = 0, ok = 0; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) { n++; if (o.isSkinnedMesh === o.parent.isSkinnedMesh && o.geometry === o.parent.geometry && o.material.wireframe) ok++; } }); return n > 0 && n === ok && __studio.human.modes.edges; })()
steps.label: Edges lays a wire overlay on every mesh that shares its geometry (and skinning)

steps.eval: (() => { document.querySelector('#huview .vm-bar button[aria-label="Edges"]').click(); let n = 0; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) n++; }); return n; })()

steps.expect: (() => { let n = 0; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) n++; }); return n === 0; })()
steps.label: Edges off takes the overlay away
X-ray makes the body see-through in the current mode

steps.eval: (() => { document.querySelector('#huview .vm-bar button[aria-label="X-ray"]').click(); __click('clay'); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'z', code: 'KeyZ' })); return __studio.human.modes.pie; })()

steps.label: Z opens the pie with the seven modes

steps.eval: (() => { dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '3', code: 'Digit3' })); return { pie: __studio.human.modes.pie, mode: __studio.human.modes.mode }; })()

steps.label: 3 in the pie picks Matcap, and the choice is remembered

steps.eval: (() => { dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Z', code: 'KeyZ', shiftKey: true })); return __studio.human.modes.edges; })()

steps.label: Shift+Z toggles the edges without the pie

steps.expect: (() => { let n = 0; __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) n++; }); return document.querySelector('#huview .vm-bar').hidden && n === 0 && __eyes().every((e) => e.material === e.userData.own); })()
steps.label: the paint mode hides the bar and draws the figure its own way
Close gives the bar and its mode back

steps.eval: (() => { dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Z', code: 'KeyZ', shiftKey: true })); __click('clay'); return __studio.human.modes.mode; })()
